I had few friends, no girlfriend, no sports stories, no fun groups I joined, no unique personal interests, and no actual achievements of any kind. I might as well not have existed really. It sunk in that nobody noticed or questioned that I wasn't in the yearbook when it came out. It didn't matter. Life, sometimes, just doesn't matter. You just have to wait, until perhaps one day, you'll actually matter to someone, somewhere.

New Las Vegas arena to host landmark UFC 200 in July 2016

LAS VEGAS -- The UFC will host its landmark UFC 200 event in the newly constructed MGM-AEG Arena located on the Las Vegas Strip on July 2, 2016.

UFC president Dana White announced the event at the UFC Fan Expo on Friday, ahead of Saturday's UFC 189 card, which is headlined by an interim featherweight title fight between Conor McGregor and Chad Mendes.

The UFC has historically targeted July for some of its most significant events, including UFC 100 on July 11, 2009, which remains the most-bought pay-per-view in UFC history.

The 20,000-seat MGM-AEG arena, located on the east side of Las Vegas Boulevard, broke ground in May 2014 and is expected to open next spring. White was one of several key speakers at the arena's ground breaking.

"Every year, we just want to make this thing bigger and bigger," said White.
